statement: The proportion of SUID cases with smoking cessation before pregnancy differs from that among PRAMS mothers.
rationale: This study aims to compare the prevalence of smoking cessation before pregnancy between SUID cases and a population reference. The case series (ncfrp_v51) provides detailed information on maternal smoking habits, while PRAMS data offers a weighted sample of live births to estimate smoking cessation behaviors in the general population.
prior_art: The manuscript claims indicate that maternal smoking during pregnancy is a significant risk factor for SUID (bedsharing_ms_v7.C9). However, there is no specific mention of smoking cessation before pregnancy. This study would provide new insights into the effectiveness of pre-pregnancy smoking cessation programs.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or temporal relationships between smoking cessation before pregnancy and SUID risk. It only compares proportions between cases and a population reference.
